findings.recommendation: Traffic Analytics classified flows with this IP as MaliciousFlow. Allowed flows mean the path is open: confirm with security operations, block the IP / tighten the rule and review the affected workloads.

findings.recommendation: Investigate blocked traffic (possible SC-04 style deny): confirm whether the deny is intended. If legitimate traffic is being dropped, review the listed NSG / security admin rule with netops-nsg-firewall-audit; if unexpected sources, treat as scanning.

evidence.note: New NSG flow logs can no longer be created; after retirement Azure deletes existing NSG flow log resources and Traffic Analytics stops for them.

findings.recommendation: Migrate to virtual network flow logs on the parent VNet (or subnet/NIC). Avoid enabling both on the same workload to prevent duplicate logging and cost.
